Zoom in / out toward the cursor (Shift = larger steps).
Change thickness of the line under the cursor (or hovered point’s line).
Rotate the selected line around its center — or the focused point if one is selected.
Pan the canvas; over a point/segment it drags that instead.
Pull a NEW point out of the line under the cursor and drag it; on a closed area the same pull breaks it open at that spot.
Reset zoom to fit the window.
Begin or finish drawing the current line.
Switch between polyline drawing and rectangle drawing.
Add a point to the line being drawn.
Close the shape into a locked, fillable area.
Sweep out a rectangle: 4 corner points, a locked area.
Turn a closed area (a closed shape or a rectangle) back into an open line — the button on the selected-line bar, or Alt+Ctrl+drag on the line itself.
Add a new point; connects to the selected line/point if one is selected.
Insert a new point between the two connecting points.
Select the line and focus the clicked point.
Delete only the focused point; with no point focused, the selected line.
Edit color, thickness, point size and style; locked areas also get a fill option.
Pick a fill color for a selected closed area; the ✕ button clears it back to transparent.
Edit point coordinates (double-click) or remove points.
Show coordinates of the nearest point or line endpoints.
Show every point of the hovered line (updates instantly).
Set default line styles, area fill and highlight colors.
Chat with an LLM that edits the image via planned Stencil operations — dock the panel to any edge, attach images/videos, and configure the provider via its ⚙ gear.

In the chat, double-click or hold the Send button (or pick Voice input from its … menu) to dictate instead of typing: the message is sent after a pause, or when you end with "send" / "execute". Click the mic or press Escape to stop.

Hands-free assistant: keeps listening even with the chat closed and sends every utterance as a message — toasts show what was sent and answered. Turn it off with the button, the shortcut, or by asking the assistant to stop voice mode. Pause length and language live in the assistant settings.
Cycle the compare view: none → original only → vertical split → horizontal split. In a split, the original is on the left/top and your current edit on the right/bottom — drag the divider to move it.
Hold to show the untouched original (crop + rotation only, no filter/lines/points); release to return to your edit.
